node.statement: Write epsilon_*:=epsilon_max^cb/2, so epsilon_*>0. Take B=C, take A=C with its exact C*-algebra structure regarded as a finite-dimensional extended epsilon_*-C*-algebra, and take v=id_C, an extended 0-inclusion (indeed an extended 0-isomorphism). The hypotheses of lem-maincb-error-improvement hold with ambient error epsilon_* and inclusion defect delta=0, because 0<=epsilon_*<=epsilon_max^cb and 0<=0<=delta_max^cb. Hence it supplies a replacement v_tilde:C->C which is an extended (c_bar*epsilon_*)-inclusion.
